pages.content:
# Commands Common commands, clicking a command will provide a detailed description
/job This command will tell you the job you are currently employed at, along with the position you hold there
/cash This command displays the amount of cash on you
/bank This command displays the amount of cash inside your bank
/e [EMOTE] /e c will cancel any emote\ \ This command will perform any emote you input\ \ **`EMOTE`:** Insert emote of your choice found in the emote menu
/skills This command will display your various skills, and their level! You can also view any boosters you have active here.
/stats This command will display your various Gym stats!
/report [MESSAGE] This command should be used to report another player if they are breaking the rules or engaging in behavior that is not tolerated. If you don't receive immediate help, please do not spam this command. For reports that require evidence or more details, please use our discord. `MESSAGE`: This field will contain a detailed description of your report or issue at hand
/me [MESSAGE] This command will display a message above your head to interpret an action based on roleplay\ `MESSAGE`: This field will contain said action you are performing
/gang This command will tell you your current gang, along with the position you hold there
/gangmenu This command allows you to create, recruit, and manage your gang
/playtime This command will tell you your current playtime in CityLife!
/vote This command will open a link where you can vote for the city to get quick and easy rewards!
/ooctoggle This command will toggle OOC feed from being seen, for that sweet peace of mind! \ \ **NOTE**: You will still see important messages!
/shuff This command will change your characters seat inside of a vehicle
/seat [0-5] This command will change your characters seat inside of a vehicle according to the # you input. Example: /seat 0 is the drivers seat!
/removeprops This command will remove any props stuck to your characters hands!
/carry This command will carry the closest player
/boost This command will reward you monthly in-game money if you're Discord Nitro boosting the CityLife Roleplay Discord!
/id This command will display your characters temporary ID used for various things around the city. It's also referred to as "paypal" or "stateid"
/hud This command will display your HUD settings. Silver supporters can customize this completely.
/scenes This command opens your scene creator menu! CityLife Supports have access to create longer scenes, depending on their supporter level! Alternative commands: `/scene`, `/scenemenu`, (BINDABLE) `/openscenesmenu`
/guide This command probably won't be useful as you're already here! But in-city, this command will open this guide for you!
/clear This command is used to clear anything inside of your chat!
/oocg To activate this feature, start by pressing 'T'. Next, tap the 'TAB' key. Lastly, type in '/oocg' followed by your message to share your thoughts in the global OOC chat! Do not spam or abuse this chat!
/oocl To activate this feature, start by pressing 'T'. Next, tap the 'TAB' key. Lastly, type in '/oocl' followed by your message to share your thoughts in the local OOC chat! Do not spam or abuse this chat!
/prisonrep This command is used to check your current prison gang, and your reputation level inside said gang.

pages.content:
# Basic Questions A short list with answers on how to do basic things around the city! > **Note:** : Try to figure out the answers to your questions in character before asking in Discord. We will not always provide you with an answer. Please keep this in mind!
I'm New! Can you show me around? Welcome to our community! While we'd love to personally guide every new member, it's not feasible due to time constraints. We encourage you to explore and learn in-character / in-game initially. Your proactive approach in seeking help here is a great first step. Enjoy discovering CityLife!
‍Whitelisted Jobs?! You can apply for whitelisted jobs in our discord server in the #applications channel. It is recommended to have a week of playtime and a firm understanding of the city before applying! Good luck!
First Job Work can be found all over the city! For more information on jobs, make sure to visit the [Job Guide](/job-guide/job-guide.md) section of our Wiki. Safe travels!
Help! I am Injured and need assistance If you're injured and need assistance, you can check in at the various hospitals around the map. Pillbox is the main hospital inside the city.\ \ You can also buy bandages from many different stores, which can help alleviate that bleeding or pain.
Setting up your Voice Chat! Check out our mini-guides section, where we have a [Voice Settings](/useful-information/useful-information/mini-guides/voice-settings.md) guide!
My Textures are Not Loading! If your textures are not loading for some reason, try increasing your Extended Texture Budget to about halfway! Find this in your **Settings > Graphics > Extended Texture Budget** ![](assets/wiki/f31d78039c0b93603066.png)
Getting a Drivers License (Currently not needed!) Trying to do something and it says you need a commercial license? No problem! Head over to the yellow steering wheel or the Driving School on your map. Once there, go up the stairs to do the exam. After successful completion of the driving exam, you must go back in the circle on-top of the stairs and complete the “Commercial Driving Test”. After successful completion of this, you will be able now to do delivery jobs, and purchase vehicles!
Help, I cannot find my car! If your car goes on an adventure without you, treat it like a one-time-use coupon. Once it's gone, you're stuck waiting for the next tsunami to bring it back from the impound lot. Be safe rather than being sorry!
The police seized my car! Where did it go?! Did the cops swipe your wheels? No worries! Keep an eye on your in-game inbox for an email with the scoop on when your ride will be back. Once the time's up, head to The Tow Lot and scoop it back from the desk near the Tow Boss. **NOTE: If it is not here, then you may need to talk to a Police Officer to have them retreive your vehicle.**
Getting a Weapons License Ready to pack some heat? Swing by the courthouse marked on your map, and buy a weapons license from a friendly staff member there when they are in-city. A word of caution though, they come at a steep price - for good reason!
How to put someone inside a vehicle / take them back out?! Simply open your radial menu ('Z' key), choose 'cuff options' for the player, and select 'Put In.' To remove the player from the vehicle, press 'L ALT' to activate your third eye and select 'Take out of Vehicle.'"
My car keeps stalling or having issues, what's wrong? If your having car troubles, worry not! Taking care of your vehicle is imperative for it's long-term health. Mechanics can fix issues with your vehicles - for a price!
How can I directly give another player items? **Here's how you can share items with another player!** 1. Press *F2*, and Choose the quantity you want to give inside the box 2. Right-click the item and select *'Give.'* 3. Check the top right of your screen, and select the name of the other player 4. Navigate using your arrow keys and confirm with *'Enter.'*
Someone else's music is too loud! How do I turn it down!? **Here's how you can lower the volume of your FiveM Chromium Process!** 1. Tab out of your game, and right click the windows speaker icon in the bottom right. 2. Click 'Open Volume Mixer' 3. Navigate to the 'FiveM Chromium subprocess' 4. Configure the volume to your taste. We recommend 25-35%!
Starting a Gang Starting a gang is simple. Find a group of people, come up with a name and color (optional), assert your dominance, and set a name for yourself. Remember, you don't always have to resort to violence to do this! Creativity and good roleplay is always rewarded and encouraged!
My FiveM keeps crashing! There may be a few factors causing this issue. Here are some possible solutions!\ Try to switch from Windowed/Borderless windowed/Fullscreen to one of the other modes, if that doesn’t fix it try to restart FiveM. If you are still having issues, [clearing your cache](#clear-my-fivem-cache) is the best option. Finally, If this option didn’t work, fully uninstall, and re-install FiveM/GTA V.
Clearing my FiveM Cache Clearing your FiveM cache can be a great way to solve various issues.\ \ Click this link to learn how to clear your cache!
How can I submit my suggestions for CityLife? Interested in suggesting new ideas for the Server? Post in the #suggestions channel Or, visit , and press New Issue!

pages.title: Gym Life
pages.content:
# Gym Life

Hit the gym to boost your physical performance! Train to increase Strength, Stamina, reduce weapon Recoil, and more!

### Getting Started

* Membership Required: Purchase at Vespucci Beach Gym for $500
* View Stats: Type /stats or Z Menu > General > Gym Stats
* Daily Focus: Changes daily - train the focus stat for 20% speed bonus!

### Gym Stats & Benefits

| Stat  | Exercises                | Benefits                            |
| ----- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------- |
| Core  | Sit-ups, Yoga            | Increases stamina & wheelie ability |
| Arms  | Dumbbells, Barbells      | Increases strength & melee damage   |
| Legs  | Treadmill, Exercise Bike | Increases stamina & sprint speed    |
| Back  | Pull-ups                 | Increases strength & posture        |
| Chest | Push-ups, Bench Press    | Increases strength & melee power    |

### Performance

* Strength = (Arms + Chest + Back) ÷ 3 → Affects melee damage & recoil
* Stamina = (Core + Legs) ÷ 2 → Affects sprint duration & swimming

### Boosts & Recovery

* Protein Shake ($75): +50% XP gain for 10 minutes + restores hunger
* Pre-Workout ($100): 30% reduced fatigue for 5 minutes + restores thirst
* Yoga: Relieves fatigue naturally

### Training Tips

* Watch your Fatigue bar - hit 100% and you'll get a 5-minute training penalty!
* Train the Daily Focus stat first for faster gains
* Use Pre-Workout before long sessions to train longer
* Take Protein Shake to maximize XP from your workout

pages.title: Treasure Maps
pages.content:
# Treasure Maps

Hunt for buried loot across San Andreas! Solve clues, track down informants, and dig up valuable treasures ranging from cash to weapons.

### Getting Started

* Acquire Maps: Earn treasure maps from various activities throughout the city
* What You'll Need: A Shovel to dig up your loot
* Time Limits: Maps expire after 30-60 minutes - act fast!

### Map Tiers

| Tier   | Difficulty | NPCs to Find   | Time Limit |
| ------ | ---------- | -------------- | ---------- |
| Tier 1 | Easy       | 0 (Direct map) | 30 min     |
| Tier 2 | Medium     | 1 NPC          | 45 min     |
| Tier 3 | Hard       | 2 NPCs         | 60 min     |
| Tier 4 | Expert     | 3 NPCs + Items | 60 min     |

### How It Works

<details>

<summary>Tier 1 - Direct Hunt:</summary>

1. Use the map item to view the image
2. Study the clues and location hints
3. Travel to the dig site (no GPS help!)
4. Dig up your treasure

</details>

<details>

<summary>Tier 2 - One Informant:</summary>

1. Use the map to set GPS to an NPC
2. Talk to the NPC to view the treasure map
3. Solve the clues and travel to the dig site
4. Dig up your treasure

</details>

<details>

<summary>Tier 3 - Two Informants:</summary>

1. Use the map to set GPS to the first NPC
2. First NPC gives you a hint and directs you to a second NPC
3. Second NPC shows you the actual treasure map
4. Solve the clues and dig up your loot

</details>

<details>

<summary>Tier 4 - Three Informants + Items</summary>

1. Track down multiple NPCs in sequence
2. Some NPCs require items to bribe or trade (burgers, SD cards, etc.)
3. Final NPC reveals the treasure location
4. Complete the hunt and claim rare rewards

</details>

pages.title: Pawnshop Rings
pages.content:
# Pawnshop Rings

Craft powerful magical rings at the Pawnshop to gain unique passive buffs! Each ring provides a different advantage but loses durability over time.

### What You'll Need

* Find a Pawnshop employee when the shop is open
* Bring Celestial Alloy - The rare material required for ALL rings
* Bring the required gems and materials

### The Rings

| Ring            | Effect                                                        | Durability Loss  |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| Ruby Ring       | Regenerates 2 HP every 15 seconds                             | 0.5% per minute  |
| Sapphire Ring   | Regenerates armor to 33% (2 armor/15s)                        | 0.5% per minute  |
| Emerald Ring    | Restores stamina when sprinting (5 uses, then 1 min cooldown) | 0.5% per minute  |
| Citrine Ring    | Removes 2 stress every 15 seconds                             | 0.5% per minute  |
| Aquamarine Ring | Faster swimming speed                                         | 0.5% per minute  |
| Onyx Ring       | Way slower hunger and thirst drain                            | 0.25% per minute |

### Usage & Maintenance

* Activation: Costs 2% durability instantly
* Passive Drain: Rings lose durability while active
* Repair: Use a Ring Repair Kit at the Pawnshop repair bench (requires Pawnshop employee)
* Cooldown: 5 seconds between equipping different rings
* One at a Time: Only one ring buff can be active

### Pro Tips

* Onyx Ring is the most efficient (0.25% drain vs 0.5%)
* Ruby & Sapphire great for combat survivability
* Emerald perfect for runners and job activities
* Aquamarine essential for diving activities
* Monitor durability - rings break at 0% and need repair!

pages.title: Fishing Lures
pages.content:
# Fishing Lures

> **Note:** You can craft Fishing Lures at the Marina table!

**Fishing Lures**

Fishing Lures can be crafted or found in Treasure Chests! They're an excellent way to improve both your chances of catching fish and the frequency of your catches.

Each lure is unique and designed for specific fishing rods. Be sure to check the item's tooltip to see which rod your lure is compatible with!

**Lure Effects:** Lures last for 30 minutes once activated and provide several benefits while active:

* **Faster Fishing:** Reduces the time between catch attempts, letting you fish more in less time
* **Better Catch Rate:** Increases your chance of successfully reeling in a fish
* **Rarer Catches:** Shifts the odds in your favor, making rare and valuable fish more likely to bite
* **Bonus XP:** Earn extra fishing experience with every catch

**Lure Tiers:**

| Lure          | Compatible Rods        | Overview                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Basic Lure    | Basic Rod              | A modest boost to get you started, slightly faster catches and a small bump to your odds                                                       |
| Advanced Lure | Saltwater Rod, Fly Rod | A solid upgrade, noticeably faster fishing, better catch rates, and improved chances at uncommon fish                                          |
| Expert Lure   | Deepsea Rod            | The best lure available, significantly faster fishing, the highest catch rate bonus, and a major shift toward rare fish like Sharks and Whales |

**Tips:**

* Only one lure can be active at a time
* Lures stack with Hotspot bonuses! Fish in a Hotspot with a lure active for the best results
* You'll get a notification when your lure helps attract a catch, so you'll know it's working!

pages.title: Upgrading Your Rig
pages.content:
# Upgrading Your Rig

Your starter rig is just the beginning! To truly maximize your mining potential, you'll need to upgrade to Tier 2 and Tier 3 components.

**The Hidden Workshop**: \
Digital Den only has the basics. To craft Tier 2 and Tier 3 upgrades, as well as Advanced Electronic Repair Kits, you'll need to locate the secret electronics workshop hidden somewhere in the city. This crafting location is where serious miners go to build high performance components. Ask around, someone might know where it is!

**Gathering Materials**: \
Upgrading requires special materials you won't find at any store. You'll need to gather components from various activities around the city, such as Dumpster Diving, Garbage Job, House Robberies, Chop shop, and more!\
\
**Mining Efficiency & Hardware Score:** \
Every component in your miner contributes to your Hardware Score, which determines how efficiently you mine and which cryptocurrencies you can access. A basic rig starts around 135 points, enough to mine Shungite. To unlock X Coin, you'll need at least 200 points, which means an extra GPU or upgrading to Tier 2 parts. The premium LME requires 300+ points and serious hardware investment. 

> TIP: The higher your score, the faster you mine and the more you earn. Keep your parts healthy though! Damaged components contribute less to your score!

| Component    | What It Does                                               |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| GPU          | More mining power! Stack up to 4 for massive multipliers   |
| Motherboard  | Determines how many GPUs you can install (2/3/4)           |
| RAM          | Boosts mining speed with each stick (up to 4)              |
| Cooling      | Improves overall efficiency                                |
| Power Supply | Powers your GPUs (bigger PSU = more GPUs)                  |
| Storage      | Determines how much crypto you can hold before withdrawing |

pages.title: Maintenance & Repairs
pages.content:
# Maintenance & Repairs

Your components wear down over time while actively mining. Keep an eye on their health!

> **Note:** : Higher tier parts last longer AND can be repaired more times. Finding that hidden workshop and investing in upgrades saves money long term!

### Health System

Parts degrade based on active mining time (not real time). When any part drops below 25% health, your miner stops working.

### Repair Kits

| Repair Kit                     | Tiers it Repairs      | How to Get                                       | Price                |
| ------------------------------ | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------- |
| Basic Electronic Repair Kit    | Tier 1 parts only     | Purchasable at Digital Den                       | $1,150               |
| Advanced Electronic Repair Kit | Tier 2 & Tier 3 parts | Craftable at Electronics Table (hidden location) | \~$1,150 (materials) |

### Repair Limits:

* Tier 1 parts: Can be repaired 2 times before replacement
* Tier 2 parts: Can be repaired 3 times before replacement 
* Tier 3 parts: Can be repaired 4 times before replacement

> **Note:** : Repairing a part does NOT reset its age! Old parts that have been mining for weeks will degrade quickly again after repair.

# Getting Started

Starting a Gang can be overwhelming, luckily, we curated some information to help you start!

### Getting Started

Starting a gang in CityLife is not a decision to be taken lightly. Building a reputation on the streets takes time, dedication, and the right people by your side. Before jumping in, consider the following:

* Establishing your gang takes time: You won't become a powerhouse overnight. Expect progression to require sustained activity before major features unlock.
* Choose your members wisely: Every member you recruit reflects on your gang. Bring in people you trust who are committed to the long-term vision, not just anyone looking for quick action.
* Quality over quantity: A tight knit crew of 6 reliable members will outperform 20 randoms who don't communicate or work together.
* Roleplay properly: Gang roleplay should enhance the server experience for everyone. Follow all server rules, avoid RDM & VDM, and create meaningful stories and rivalries.
* Respect the grind - The progression system is designed to reward consistent effort. There are no shortcuts.

***

####  Commands

| Command   | Description                                                |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| /gangmenu | Open the gang management menu (create, recruit, view info) |
| /gang     | Quick gang information                                     |

***

####  Costs

| Action           | Cost                   |
| ---------------- | ---------------------- |
| Create a Gang    | 2,000 SHUNG ($100,000) |
| Recruit a Member | 400 SHUNG ($20,000)    |

***

#### Tips for Success

1. Communicate - Use radios, or in game voice to coordinate (Not Discord)
2. Diversify activities - Don't just grind one thing; mix heists, boosting, and drug ops
3. Build alliances - Not every gang needs to be an enemy
4. Protect your reputation - How you carry yourself matters in the criminal underworld
5. Stay active - Inactive gangs fall behind, keep your crew engaged

# Gang Unlocks

This article describes the available unlocks you can obtain as you level your Gang!

## Earning XP as a Gang

Your gang earns XP through various criminal activities across the city.. XP is awarded for completing heists, robberies, boosting vehicles, and other illegal operations. Higher tier activities reward more XP for example, a Pacific Standard bank job grants significantly more than an ATM robbery. Each gang member receives the full XP amount (not split), but there's a 1,000 XP cap per player per restart to prevent power leveling. Notably, selling drugs from your own grow operation does not grant XP; however, selling another gang's product will award XP to the gang who grew it. Complete eligible activities to progress through the levels and unlock warehouses, upgrades, and eventually the ability to raid rival gang operations at level 25.

# Whitelisted Gangs

 This article describes the available unlocks you obtain when your gang is officially Whitelisted!!

#### Official Territory

Whitelisted gangs receive designated territory on the map.. This area becomes your gang's turf where you can establish dominance, conduct operations, and defend against rivals.

#### Gang Sprays & Graffiti

* Claim Territory - Spray your gang's custom graffiti on walls to mark turf
* Turf Radius - Each spray claims a radius around it
* NPC Dealers - Gang NPCs spawn near your sprays
* Contest Rival Sprays - Scratch enemy graffiti to take over their territory
* Spray Shop - Purchase spray cans (price scales with level) and spray remover

#### Crafting Bench

Each whitelisted gang receives a dedicated crafting bench at a unique location. At the bench, gang members can craft:

* Weapons
* Ammunition
* Armor
* Gang-exclusive items
* Other crafting recipes

#### Rob Law Enforcement

Whitelisted gangs gain access to the ability to rob police officers. This high risk activity allows gang members to take items from law enforcement during confrontations. Whitelisted gangs are trusted to not abuse this ability.

# How to Get Whitelisted

Becoming an official whitelisted gang unlocks exclusive features like territory, gang sprays, crafting benches, and more. But whitelist status isn't handed out freely, it's earned.

### Groups seeking whitelisted faction status must:

| Requirement          | Details                                                                |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Established Presence | Demonstrate a presence within the server and gain recognition          |
| Strong Roleplay      | Exhibit strong roleplay skills that align with server rules as a group |
| Member Count         | Have no more than 25 members and no fewer than 5 members               |
| Authentic RP         | Maintain a commitment to authentic criminal gang/organization roleplay |

***

### How to Apply

Once your gang meets the requirements above, submit a whitelist application through our official Discord: CityLife Gangs & Factions Discord

***

### What Happens Next?

* Staff will review your gang's activity, reputation, and history
* You may be asked questions or given feedback
* If approved, your gang will be granted whitelist status and gain access to all exclusive features

***

> **Note:** Whitelist status can be revoked if your gang fails to maintain good standing or breaks server rules. There are also strike systems in place!

# House Robberies

House Robberies Procedure

1. **Find the Right Boss**\
   Your first stop is the underworld contact who deals in black-market break-ins. Seek out this “boss” for the chance to prove your skill. Without their nod of approval, you won’t get anywhere near the lucrative neighborhoods.
2. **Choose the Perfect Moment**\
   Patience pays off in any successful robbery. Timing is everything, and you’ll likely need a certain number of officers on duty to keep the heat balanced. If there aren’t enough officers patrolling, you’ll have to lie low until circumstances are right.
3. **Arm Yourself with the Right Tools**\
   Houses aren’t pushovers—especially in a well-protected city. Secure any specialized gear your that's required for a forced entry. If you show up unprepared, you’ll be turning around empty-handed.
4. **Get the Target Location**\
   Once you’re set with your gear, return to the boss. They’ll give you a location that’s ripe for the picking. Listen carefully—the last thing you want to do is break into the wrong place!
5. **Enter with Caution**\
   Slip inside quietly. Keep your noise to a minimum—pets might bark, neighbors might snoop, and homeowners might be lurking. One wrong move can set off alarms, so stay on your toes.
6. **Follow the Group App**\
   If your crew has a shared app or in-game system, keep an eye on it for any updates or intel. New objectives might pop up as you move from room to room, like searching for safes or picking the right locks.
7. **Exit and Evade**\
   Once you’ve gathered the goods, head for the exit. Make it quick—every second spent inside risks discovery. When you’re clear, hope your luck holds out and no sirens catch up to you.
8. **Reap the Rewards (Or Lie Low)**\
   If all goes well, drop off your haul or lay low for a bit. Bragging rights aside, you don’t want your name circulating among the wrong crowds—or the local police blotter.

 Quick cash is just a drill, or a rope away.

Faster execution, standard payout What You'll Need:

* Drill – Your primary breaching tool
* Drill Bit – Can't drill without it

1. Approach the ATM and equip your drill
2. Bore through the ATM's security panel
3. Extract the cash once the drilling is complete

#### METHOD 2: The Rope

Takes longer, bigger payout. What You'll Need:

* A Vehicle, Something with towing power
* Rope, To yank the ATM from its foundation
* A Jack hammer

How It Works:

1. Secure a vehicle capable of pulling the ATM
2. Attach the rope to both your vehicle and the ATM
3. Floor it and rip the ATM from the ground
4. The extraction takes time, defend your position
5. Once loose, drive around until the ATM Security System De-activates

If you are intoxicated to the point where your ability to follow the rules is impaired, staff have the right to
remove you from the server until you become sober. Furthermore, any rule breaks whilst intoxicated will
be held against you as if you were sober. Drink/smoke and play responsibly.

Character Rules

Before making your character there is important information you should know before doing so!

Realistic Character Names
You must choose a realistic name for your character, it cannot contain any harmful, vulgar language, or
sound like some, and also must not be in connection to any person that would be deemed famous in real
life

Examples:
Do not have names like: "Ben Dover", "Steve Harvey", "Looney Tunes/Chicken Little". Any fictional cartoon
character names/series are not allowed. You will be banned. If this happens to you, open a ticket.

Character Separation and Affiliation
To maintain an authentic and immersive roleplaying environment, each of your characters must exist
independently from one another. They should not share knowledge of personal information,
relationships, or backgrounds beyond what is established in roleplay. Furthermore, having multiple
characters affiliated with the same circle or gang is strictly prohibited. Each character should possess a
unique identity, set of connections, and associations. By respecting this clear separation, you help foster
diverse, engaging, and realistic interactions for everyone in the community.

Wearing Starter Clothing
You must customize your character's appearance upon joining the server for the first time. You cannot
exit the spawn point with the default appearance unless you are heading to the clothing store/barber
shop to fix your look.

Value of liƒe
Your character's life is the most important thing to you, you should not take it's life for granted or as a
joke, and not fear the consequences of getting seriously injured/killed.

Examples:
- Not putting your hands up when being held up
Pulling out a weapon when one/numerous are already drawn towards you
Jumping off high surfaces in an attempt to escape someone, when it's very obvious your
character will die
- Jumping in front of cars that are moving, standing in front of a car in an attempt to stop it
Don't think you're John Wick

Taking a life must have a good roleplay reason behind it, your primary reason for trying to kill someone
should not be so they don't remember something insignificant.

New Life Rule
. If a player chooses to respawn, they are considered to have no memory of the events leading up to
their incapacitation.
. As such, they may not seek revenge on any individual involved in their death.
. A player may only seek revenge if they were:
. Transported to Pillbox Medical, or
. Received medical treatment from ems /pd
. A witness may inform the player of what occurred to refresh their memory, allowing for
appropriate in-character action.

When dying, you should stay away from whoever killed you and not bring up a prior incident for at least
30 minutes. To go back to the killer/confront them you must be reminded by someone. NLR ties into gang
conflict, if your group gets spun and everyone dies/goes down, none of you will know exactly what
happened or who did it. Refrain from talking about details as to what happened when you get
killed/incapped/downed.

Character Killing
For an execution to occur, there must be:
. High-quality roleplay involved
. Ifyou "perma" your character, it must be deleted.

Once you are Character Killed there is no coming back. You can CK by deleting your character or if dying
from a scene you signify in some way that yes, your character is dead. "/me male is dead", "/me no
pulse", etc. This is also with no exceptions, irreversible.

Roleplay Rules

Misuse of /Me's
The purpose of /me's is to describe actions that can't be shown through emotes or aren't visually obvious.
For example, "male smells of alcohol" or "has a bullet in shoulder" are acceptable uses. Inappropriate use
includes "ABC did it to you!" or spamming /me's. If a /me doesn't immediately reveal something you'd

know, like "thinks about killing [Tom]," you won't know about it, but could observe that the person who
did the /me looks angry or etc. Also, avoid reading /me's out loud through voice chat, except when it's
about another character's appearance, like "female would have a missing arm." If you see "Is Looking
into Your Soul," don't acknowledge it.

It's also expected to cooperate with /me's. If prompted by PD/EMS with a "inspects what wounds person
would have," respond with a truthful /me explaining your injuries, or do the same if your radio is
checked.

Illegal Bragging
Posting excessively on social media about drugs/guns/dead bodies/anything illegal will result in a ban, if
you do it occasionally it's okay, be prepared for the Police to investigate you!

Disclosing Illegal Locations
Trying to purchase or sell: drugs, money, or concealed spot locations is prohibited (you can sell drugs, just
not the locations). These locations are intended to be uncovered through roleplay and character
development. Handing out such information too easily undermines the roleplay experience.

Low Effort RP
You should invest effort in your roleplay. Repeatedly shooting, evading the police unnecessarily, and using
extreme actions in minor situations is considered low-effort roleplay. For instance, fleeing a traffic stop
and shooting when you'd only receive a speeding ticket or consistently using motorcycles for robberies.
Always winning every situation is not allowed. Engaging in meaningless shootouts without proper
context or disrupting businesses for enjoyment is unacceptable. Going to Pillbox to hide after committing
serious crimes for 45 minutes to cool off falls into the same category.

Voice ID
If someone has a mask on and in an outfit you've never seen before, you cannot assume who they are
based off of their voice.

Breaking Character
You are expected to stay in character at all times while playing in the server. You should also learn lingo
to help circumvent saying things like "keyboard", "monitor", "pc", etc that refer to things in the real
world.

Examples of breaking character:
· Referring to staff as "gods", "government", etc.
. Referencing your other character as your "cousin"
. Referencing that you record/stream or use the term "bodycam"
. Referencing bans as "deported" or "sent on a vacation"
. Saying "in my head" then proceed to mention something about you IRL.

Body Camping
After killing someone, you cannot stay around the area to ensure EMS are unable to do their job and save
them. If you kill an officer you should not be hanging around the body as multiple officers are going to
arrive and your main focus should be getting out of the area. This isn't exclusive for only prohibiting
PD/EMS, but also stopping other crims/civs trying to help incapped players.

Cop Baiting
Doing stupid things so the police come to you or try to arrest/pull you over (Baiting them to come to
you for a reaction). Absolutely NOT allowed, it will result in a BAN. Also doing anything that would be
deemed completely unrealistic/foolish solely to get a cop's attention. Example: Purposely doing a
burnout/donut in front of a cop at an intersection, near missing a cop on a scene, etc.
(this includes injecting yourself in and around cop scenes if you are not involved)

Vigilante RP
This is where a player takes the law into their own hands rather than calling law enforcement.

Terrorism RP
This is not allowed. However, explosives are available and if RP'd correctly, are allowed.

Inappropriate Sexual Conduct
If you want to indulge in erotic roleplay, both parties must give consent. If both parties do not consent
then this would be considered sexual harassment which is taken extremely seriously. You will be banned
without question and your appeal will not be looked at.

On the topic of sexual discourse, the unwanted comments about another player's sexual anatomy or
genitalia are considered inappropriate. The discussion of sexual themes needs consent of all parties
involved.

No Intent to Roleplay
Exactly as it sounds, if you do not have any intent to actually roleplay here you will be removed.

Fail RP
Fail RP refers to unrealistic actions or a failure to roleplay appropriately. This term covers a wide range of
actions, all of which are prohibited. For instance, passing items through 5-inch thick glass to a friend in
jail

Bringing individuals to Grandma's/the Hospital to revive them and then robbing, torturing, or killing
them is grounds for a ban. Once you've killed someone for a specific reason, you cannot harm or pursue
them further for the same reason; it's over, and you should keep your distance.

Metagaming:
Using any information that your character did not obtain through roleplay to affect in-game actions or
decisions. This includes using information from discord or live streams. Mixing memories from 2 different
characters is not allowed. If you are restrained or if your communication devices have been removed then
you must make yourself inactive on any other forms of communication besides proximity chat.

Powergaming
Trying to misuse roleplay to exploit game mechanics for an advantage or winning within roleplay. Such as
excessive jump spamming, failing to correctly assess your injuries, or using radio unrealistically when
handcuffed or with hands up, is not allowed. Quick example: hiding equipped weapons via emotes.

Using combat helmets as a civilian or criminal is also prohibited. Using bulletproof louvers on the back of
your vehicle is not allowed. Installing bulletproof body panels/windows is not allowed.

Abuse of a Whitelisted Job
You should not be conducting any illegal activities while on duty at your job. You should not be on duty
and not do your job, just to receive a paycheck.

Addition to this, you cannot abuse in-game mechanics granted by your job to benefit your experience,
examples are:
. Mechanics putting parts on their own cars for free
. Dynasty Agents giving themselves a free house
. Un-jailing/un-bedding your friends from the hospital because they're "your friend"
. Using any discord log or channel information to gain in-character information (eg: license plates)

When joining a whitelisted job, your intention should be to perform your duties fairly and in line with the
job's objectives. This means:
. Cops should not leave evidence on their friends, give their friends unfair advantages, sell
evidence, improperly transfer evidence, be corrupt, etc.
. DOJ members should not utilize the MDT for personal benefit outside of lawyer duties, same with
EMS, etc.

Group Limits
You shall not be in a group that is larger than 5 people in criminal scenes. This number will not change
regardless of police presence. Swapping members out mid-scene is strictly prohibited. Lookouts, drivers,
and scouts count towards the number. To put it plainly, the only people involved at all should be the 5
chosen. Nobody outside the 5 should be aiding in any way to the scene. They shouldn't be on the radio
giving you callouts, preparing cars, picking up bodies before the scene is over, absolutely nothing. It's up
to that 5 and that's it.

You can not Impersonate Officers/EMS/DoJ
Do not use the clothing/ped models that are associated with emergency services.
Stealing emergency vehicles without any RP involved falls under this category. This includes ANY plane(s),
helicopters, tanks, jets, transport vehicles, cargobobs, military helicopters etc as well. It is also frowned
upon to attempt to scam players of services that judges would perform, like selling gun licenses, name
changes, expungements, etc.

Gang Conflict
In the sense of griefing, "beef" between two groups must have valid roleplay reasoning behind it, so if a
third party is told about it, they could also agree as to why there is beef in the first place. It must make
sense, and have high quality roleplay behind it. Beef shouldn't be forced upon another group, because
clearly if it's valid, both sides would understand it. During the beef, both parties must be providing high
quality roleplay the entire time, at no point should anyone be delivering anything but that, or breaking
rules. Group managers/staff have the right to step in and forcefully stop/alter beef at any time if deemed
necessary.

Ocean Dumping
Ocean dumping should be a last resort and used sparingly.

When someone is ocean dumped, they forget major storyline details related to a group or activity they
should forget. Those initiating the ocean dump must explain why they're doing it, like, "We can't let you
roam freely knowing our operations."

Valid reasons for ocean dumping include:
- A cop discovering your gang's plans or illegal hideout, which, if remembered, could lead to
trouble like raids.
Someone is leaving your gang, and you want them to forget critical information related to it.
Catching someone repeatedly spying on your gang, and they know too much.

Be aware that improperly or invalidly dumping someone results in harsh punishments, regardless of your
ban history. If an ocean dump is deemed invalid, the victim player(s) will be immune from further
attempts and they'll retain all storyline information they were meant to forget.

Situational Rules

Getting Downed
You must tell the truth about what happened (Stabbed, Gunshots, Runover) if you don't this will be
deemed as Fail RP. You can talk when you're down as long as the injury isn't immediately fatal, and when
you talk it's about your injuries. so feel free to RP groaning, crying, etc. You should not be talking
normally if you're downed/dead. Talking trash to a dead body excessively is not tolerated.

Gang Rules

For a detailed list of all gang rules and expectations, please visit this link: G CityLife Gang Guidelines

Combat Rules

Random Death Match (RDM)
Attacking another player/group without any story/roleplay leading up to it. There should always be build
up or a story behind every death. You must initiate prior to shooting/killing someone. Reference "Value of
Life," what happens in the scene must be valid for the attempt/murder of the other player. You should not
kill someone for being in a certain area when the job forces them to be there (legal jobs like trucking,
fishing, hunting, etc.). With initiation, it should not be a one-line thing; there should actively be back &
forth dialogue, RP is a two-way street. The only exception to this is at Airdrops or Outpost.

Examples of bad reasons/initiations:
. Any "one liners," "what those colors mean to you," "hey buddy," "stay off our block!," "abc did it
to you!”
. Killing someone because they are annoying
. Killing someone because you got into a vehicle accident with them
. Killing someone because they are refusing you service at businesses/courthouse
. Killing someone because they are doing a legal job (trucking, fishing, hunting, etc.)
. Killing someone because they are wearing a random piece of clothing that has the same color as
your gang
. Killing someone because their vehicle is the color of your gang. You will be permanently banned
ƒor this.

Examples of good reasons/initiations:
. Escalated tension from multiple disrespectful encounters (not just a single comment)
. A known rival gang entering your turf during an active beef and provoking your group
Someone snitching on your gang with clear IC proof (bodycam, wire, etc.)
. Retaliating for a recent shooting, robbery, or ambush by a rival gang

. A player actively interfering with your illegal operation (trap spot, drop, etc.)
You're threatened with serious harm (robbery, death) and follow up later with planned retaliation
· A kidnapping setup used to intimidate or provoke a rival gang
. A rival consistently provoking conflict across multiple scenes with clear RP buildup

If a shootout pauses for over 5 minutes (both parties leave the scene), you must reinitiate.

Vehicular Death Match (VDM)
Attacking another player/group using a vehicle, the attempt is still not allowed.

GTA Driving
Driving a vehicle in a manner that any sensible person would deem as incredibly unrealistic as it'd cause
severe injury or death to you and others. You can take stunt jumps around the map, especially in getaway
chases. Some examples of what not to do are:
. Do not drive off the pier or into the ocean
. Do not drive into vehicles head-on, as a heat seeking missile
. Do not drive a vehicle off-road/up a mountain, that clearly shouldn't be
. Do not ram other vehicles at speeds that would cause severe injury or death
. Do not use your vehicle to purposely disable other vehicles
. Do not drive off a very high point in a motorcycle/car

Hostages/Kidnapping
When taking hostages, you must provide high-quality roleplay. You can not use fake hostages such as
friends or group members. Hostages should be kept no longer than 45 minutes if a scene is not lasting
longer. Generally, the police only allow 1 demand per hostage. If you wish to kidnap a member of PD or
EMS, it must be for a valid RP reason that ties directly into the storyline.

If members are being chased by the cops they are not allowed to go back to your block where there are
an excess of 5 members to set up an ambush.

If another group rolls up to your street and opens fire, you are only allowed to chase with a maximum of
5 people no exceptions.

Gang Wars
A Gang War is a war gangs agree to go into against each other where they can set terms and
stipulations. Official Gang Wars must have terms agreed to and approved by a Group Manager (staff).
These terms can alter some of the basic Combat and Criminal rules of the server.

Recording Gameplay
. Always Record: You must be recording your gameplay at all times, including both game and mic
audio.
. Retention: Keep all clips for at least 7 days after any incident.

. Staff Requests: If staff requests your footage (for kills or other incidents) and you cannot provide
it, you will be banned for 2 weeks.
. No Editing/Tampering: Edited or incomplete clips aren't allowed. Tampering or providing fake
evidence results in permanent removal.
. Recommended Software: We suggest using NVIDIA Shadowplay or Medal.tv.

Robbery Rules

Lootboxing
Looting any player without much roleplay presented for them is prohibited.

Robbing stores/banks
You can not chain rob stores or banks, please use common sense. You must wait a minimum of 45
minutes between store robberies and minimum 2 hours between bank robberies.
. You can not use super/hyper cars in store/bank robberies.
. Do not initiate any heists 15 minutes prior/post server restart
. You cannot counter a heist/store robbery that is already in progress.

Robbing
Robbing should not be motivated by financial gain; avoid robbing people simply because you're low on
ƒunds.

To initiate a robbery, two essential conditions must be met:
. High-quality roleplay is required.
. A compelling reason for the robbery must be established.

During a robbery, you must continue to engage in dialogue after initiating the hold-up. Remaining silent
during a robbery will result in a ban. Ideally, while the victim is being held up, someone in your group
should explain why they're being robbed. For example, "You had it coming; shouldn't have kept coming
back after we told you this isn't your spot"effort

When robbing someone, you can only take what's in their inventory. You cannot demand bank transfers,
force them to sell their cars, or remove items from their home. Excessive robbing and inventory wiping
are not allowed, meaning don't wipe it or take random items that don't make sense.

Chain robbing at an illegal location without a strong roleplay background is strictly prohibited.
Consistently robbing every player you encounter is not allowed.

This rule is heavily enforced. Please know your limits before attempting to rob an officer. Failure to abide
by this will result in harsh punishments of 2 weeks to a month ban. Robbing law enforcement should not
be for financial gain or due to them performing their duty. It has to be when an officer has gone above
and beyond their line of duty in some way with criminals, trash talking or being called mean names
doesn't warrant a cop being robbed. It must involve proper premeditated roleplay, and be approved by
an admin+.

You cannot rob or kidnap the same player more than once in a 2-hour period. If you rob someone, you
can't later kill them if they comply; it's one or the other. You either kill them or rob them and let them go.

If you're being robbed, refrain from taunting or trash-talking the robbers, thinking you're immune to
being killed. Play the victim role.

Outside Help
If you involve anyone outside your immediate group during a heist (such as store or bank robberies), you
must inform the police at the scene. Having a getaway driver or a non-violent accomplice waiting outside
is allowed, but you may not organize a planned ambush to kill police. Any outside assistance should
remain passive and not act as gunmen waiting to engage without initiation. If the situation escalates,
using deadly force with outside help should be a last resort-only after all other high-effort escape
options have failed. Planning a violent intervention from the start is considered low-effort roleplay and
will result in a ban for the entire group.


WHITELISTING PROCESS

CityLife Gang Guidelines

Groups seeking whitelisted faction status must meet the following criteria:

. Demonstrate an active presence within the server and gain community recognition.
. Exhibit strong roleplay skills that align with server rules as a group.
. Have between 10 and 25 members.
. Maintain a commitment to authentic criminal gang/organization roleplay.
. Have been part of the server for at least 30 days.
. Develop depth around your group to ensure it is ready for official gang recognition.

Note: The whitelisting process applies only to criminal roleplay groups. Family
or friend groups should not apply.

GENERAL RULES

. Roster Compliance: Only members listed on the gang roster may represent the
gang (e.g., wearing flags or participating in gang conflicts).
. Cooldown Period: A one-week cooldown applies after leaving a gang before joining
another, unless approved by staff.
. Gang Exclusivity: Players are limited to one gang character and may only belong to
one gang at a time.
. No Roleplay Checking: If you suspect a rule break, submit a report rather than
breaking character or abusing OOC chat.

CONDUCT & TOXICITY
Toxic behaviour is strictly prohibited, including but not limited to:

. Making excessive toxic remarks towards downed enemies.
. Maliciously taunting or "malding" over defeats.
. Mag dumping a downed player excessively.
. Making comments like "spinning until they don't wake up."
. Gathering at Pillbox or Grandma's to harass downed players after a fight.
. Bringing toxicity to the gang discord or targeting other members
. After a fight with another gang, don't go to the discord to "mald", if a rule was
broken use the proper channels to report it.
. Bringing attention to people making reports in an attempt to discourage them

Be respectful to roleplay and the cooldown periods.

GANG CONFLICT RULES

. New members must spend one week in the group before participating in gang
wars.
. Only rostered members can engage in gang wars.
. Legitimate Roleplay Reasons are required for war. Alliances are prohibited.
. Borrowing members from other gangs during conflicts is not allowed.
. Teaming with other gangs is prohibited.
. A 30-minute cooldown is recommended between fights unless both sides agree
otherwise. This applies to the entire gang after a gang-related shooting.
. The "5-man rule" applies to conflicts.
. Gang leaders should negotiate war terms beforehand to maintain fairness. Terms
should be posted in gang leader channels or submitted via a Discord ticket.

. Losing gangs must meet war terms within 7 days to avoid LQRP concerns.
. POV Requirement:
o Gang members must have their POV available for up to 7 days after a
conflict.
o If accused of cheating with a suspicious clip, failure to provide POV proving
this false will result in a permanent ban.
. War Participation: If your gang is at war, you are too. There are no exceptions.
. Low-Quality Roleplay (LQRP):
o Walking around high-traffic areas unarmed to avoid robberies while your
gang is at war/conflict is considered LQRP and may be seen as NVL.

GANG COLORS & FLAGS

. Gangs must wear their colors during conflicts and wars.
. Gang-on-gang disputes should always involve wearing colors, not blacked-out
outfits.
. Gang members must be clearly identifiable from a distance.
. If a term excludes certain members from war, they must wear specific different
attire as per the agreed conditions.

VEHICLES

. Bulletproof cars are strictly prohibited and will be considered power gaming.

REPORTING RULES

. Revenge Reporting is not allowed and will result in dismissal and/or bans.
. Reports must be submitted within 48 hours of the incident.
. Baiting reports will result in a ban.
. False reports will result in a ban.

ROBBERY RULES

. Only whitelisted gangs may rob downed members of other gangs.
. When robbing dead cops, you must wait until the scene has finished. You cannot
rob police officers during the middle of any given scene.
. You cannot loot box cops during a fight to replenish yourself with supplies
. You cannot force a shootout with the police just with the intention of robbing
them, this will be deemed as Low Quality roleplay.
. You may ONLY rob one cop per scene. If you have a team of five, each person
standing may loot ONE cop.
O If you access an inventory of a downed officer, that counts as your one
body; you cannot go body to body finding who has the best loot.
. There must be a minimum of five cops on scene to rob their bodies.
. Has to stem from an airdrop, high-tier robbery, a gang vs gang vs cops shootout, or
a similarly high-stakes situation.

BLUEPRINT WARS

. Gangs may go to war over blueprints from another gang's bench.
. High-quality roleplay is required in blueprint conflicts.
. A one-month cooldown applies after successfully winning a blueprint unless
otherwise approved by staff.
. Gangs may not stockpile blueprints.
. Staff reserves the right to adjust blueprint rules as needed.
. Quality roleplay is needed for a blueprint push, reasons such as but not limited to:
"We just want it", "For fun", or anything along those lines is not an acceptable
reason to push a gangʼs blueprint.
. Blueprint Pushes must be approved by GM's.

GANG DISBANDMENT

. Disbanded gangs may no longer operate as a gang.
. Members of a disbanded gang must wait 30 days before joining another gang.
. While on cooldown, disbanded members:
May not act as a gang.
May not wear gang flags.
o Must roleplay as civilians or small-time criminals.
. Inactive gangs may lose whitelist status to make room for more active groups.
. Gangs failing to meet whitelisted standards may have their status revoked.

INACTIVITY & STRIKES

. Inactive gangs may lose access to their bench or warehouse.
. Rule-breaking involving multiple members may result in a gang strike.
. Gang strikes last for 60 days before being removed.
. Gang leaders are responsible for their members' actions.

BLOCK RULES

. No Block Baiting: Do not bait near a block to gain an advantage.
. Block Pushing: After winning a 5-man fight, gangs may push an opposing gang's
block immediately.
. A 30-minute cooldown begins once a block push is initiated.

Whitelisted vs. Non-Whitelisted Gangs:

. Non-whitelisted gangs cannot contest the block of a whitelisted gang.
. Non-whitelisted gangs may use and defend an unclaimed block, but they cannot
claim it until whitelisted.

Block Antagonism:

. Circling another gang's block without intent to engage will be considered baiting.

Castle Rule
The castle rule is when players in a gang and/or group are hanging out PASSIVELY
at their known OWNED street/block/area while over group limit. If another player
or group attempts to shoot at the players that are already passively hanging out
they may return fire, in self defense.
. This only applies for whitelisted gangs, if you are not whitelisted you cannot
utilize any "castle" to your advantage.

SPRAY RULES

. Defense Limit:
o A maximum of five members may defend a spray.

Prevents metagaming and unfair advantages.

THIRD-PARTY DISCORDS

. The use of external Discord servers for RP coordination is strictly prohibited.
· Why?
0
o Ensures transparency and fairness in roleplay.
o Encourages in-game communication.
O Bypassing Official Channels: Official channels are designed to ensure
transparency, structure, and fairness, which third-party platforms
undermine.

** Violations will result in disciplinary action .**

We've hand crafted various tabs inside this Wiki to help you navigate through the many different aspects that you will stumble upon during your adventure here at CityLife. P.S, different pages of the wiki have tips & warnings that are wise to abide by!

> **Note:** : Before connecting, it is HIGHLY recommended that you read the [Rules](wiki:rules)!

1. Please ensure that you have the <mark style="color:blue;">Civilian</mark> rank on our Discordbefore attempting to join!
2. On the FiveM main menu, press **F8.**
3. Type “connect play.cl-rp.net**”** in the text bar and press ENTER
4. Press F8 to close the console and click on **“PLAY NOW”** when the button appears.

<details>

<summary>Having issues connecting?</summary>

1. Do you have the Civilian Rank in our Discord? If not, click the green button in #Rules
2. Try restarting FiveM and Steam if you can't join
3. Try clearing your FiveM Cache
4. Try running Steam as Administrator

</details>

# Commands Common commands, clicking a command will provide a detailed description
/job This command will tell you the job you are currently employed at, along with the position you hold there
/cash This command displays the amount of cash on you
/bank This command displays the amount of cash inside your bank
/e [EMOTE] /e c will cancel any emote\ \ This command will perform any emote you input\ \ **`EMOTE`:** Insert emote of your choice found in the emote menu
/skills This command will display your various skills, and their level! You can also view any boosters you have active here.
/stats This command will display your various Gym stats!
/report [MESSAGE] This command should be used to report another player if they are breaking the rules or engaging in behavior that is not tolerated. If you don't receive immediate help, please do not spam this command. For reports that require evidence or more details, please use our discord. `MESSAGE`: This field will contain a detailed description of your report or issue at hand
/me [MESSAGE] This command will display a message above your head to interpret an action based on roleplay\ `MESSAGE`: This field will contain said action you are performing
/gang This command will tell you your current gang, along with the position you hold there
/gangmenu This command allows you to create, recruit, and manage your gang
/playtime This command will tell you your current playtime in CityLife!
/vote This command will open a link where you can vote for the city to get quick and easy rewards!

wikiPages.content:
# Basic Questions A short list with answers on how to do basic things around the city! > **Note:** : Try to figure out the answers to your questions in character before asking in Discord. We will not always provide you with an answer. Please keep this in mind!
I'm New! Can you show me around? Welcome to our community! While we'd love to personally guide every new member, it's not feasible due to time constraints. We encourage you to explore and learn in-character / in-game initially. Your proactive approach in seeking help here is a great first step. Enjoy discovering CityLife!
‍Whitelisted Jobs?! You can apply for whitelisted jobs in our discord server in the #applications channel. It is recommended to have a week of playtime and a firm understanding of the city before applying! Good luck!
First Job Work can be found all over the city! For more information on jobs, make sure to visit the [Job Guide](/job-guide/job-guide.md) section of our Wiki. Safe travels!
Help! I am Injured and need assistance If you're injured and need assistance, you can check in at the various hospitals around the map. Pillbox is the main hospital inside the city.\ \ You can also buy bandages from many different stores, which can help alleviate that bleeding or pain.
Setting up your Voice Chat! Check out our mini-guides section, where we have a [Voice Settings](/useful-information/useful-information/mini-guides/voice-settings.md) guide!
My Textures are Not Loading! If your textures are not loading for some reason, try increasing your Extended Texture Budget to about halfway! Find this in your **Settings > Graphics > Extended Texture Budget** ![](assets/wiki/f31d78039c0b93603066.png)
Getting a Drivers License (Currently not needed!) Trying to do something and it says you need a commercial license? No problem! Head over to the yellow steering wheel or the Driving School on your map. Once there, go up the stairs to do the exam. After successful completion of the driving exam, you must go back in the circle on-top of the stairs and complete the “Commercial Driving Test”. After successful completion of this, you will be able now to do delivery jobs, and purchase vehicles!
Help, I cannot find my car! If your car goes on an adventure without you, treat it like a one-time-use coupon. Once it's gone, you're stuck waiting for the next tsunami to bring it back from the impound lot. Be safe rather than being sorry!
The police seized my car! Where did it go?! Did the cops swipe your wheels? No worries! Keep an eye on your in-game inbox for an email with the scoop on when your ride will be back. Once the time's up, head to The Tow Lot and scoop it back from the desk near the Tow Boss. **NOTE: If it is not here, then you may need to talk to a Police Officer to have them retreive your vehicle.**
Getting a Weapons License Ready to pack some heat? Swing by the courthouse marked on your map, and buy a weapons license from a friendly staff member there when they are in-city. A word of caution though, they come at a steep price - for good reason!
How to put someone inside a vehicle / take them back out?! Simply open your radial menu ('Z' key), choose 'cuff options' for the player, and select 'Put In.' To remove the player from the vehicle, press 'L ALT' to activate your third eye and select 'Take out of Vehicle.'"
My car keeps stalling or having issues, what's wrong? If your having car troubles, worry not! Taking care of your vehicle is imperative for it's long-term health. Mechanics can fix issues with your vehicles - for a price!
How can I directly give another player items? **Here's how you can share items with another player!** 1. Press *F2*, and Choose the quantity you want to give inside the box 2. Right-click the item and select *'Give.'* 3. Check the top right of your screen, and select the name of the other player 4. Navigate using your arrow keys and confirm with *'Enter.'*
Someone else's music is too loud! How do I turn it down!? **Here's how you can lower the volume of your FiveM Chromium Process!** 1. Tab out of your game, and right click the windows speaker icon in the bottom right. 2. Click 'Open Volume Mixer' 3. Navigate to the 'FiveM Chromium subprocess' 4. Configure the volume to your taste. We recommend 25-35%!
Starting a Gang Starting a gang is simple. Find a group of people, come up with a name and color (optional), assert your dominance, and set a name for yourself. Remember, you don't always have to resort to violence to do this! Creativity and good roleplay is always rewarded and encouraged!
My FiveM keeps crashing! There may be a few factors causing this issue. Here are some possible solutions!\ Try to switch from Windowed/Borderless windowed/Fullscreen to one of the other modes, if that doesn’t fix it try to restart FiveM. If you are still having issues, [clearing your cache](#clear-my-fivem-cache) is the best option. Finally, If this option didn’t work, fully uninstall, and re-install FiveM/GTA V.
Clearing my FiveM Cache Clearing your FiveM cache can be a great way to solve various issues.\ \ Click this link to learn how to clear your cache!
How can I submit my suggestions for CityLife? Interested in suggesting new ideas for the Server? Post in the #suggestions channel Or, visit , and press New Issue!

# Gym Life

Hit the gym to boost your physical performance! Train to increase Strength, Stamina, reduce weapon Recoil, and more!

### Getting Started

* Membership Required: Purchase at Vespucci Beach Gym for $500
* View Stats: Type /stats or Z Menu > General > Gym Stats
* Daily Focus: Changes daily - train the focus stat for 20% speed bonus!

### Gym Stats & Benefits

| Stat  | Exercises                | Benefits                            |
| ----- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------- |
| Core  | Sit-ups, Yoga            | Increases stamina & wheelie ability |
| Arms  | Dumbbells, Barbells      | Increases strength & melee damage   |
| Legs  | Treadmill, Exercise Bike | Increases stamina & sprint speed    |
| Back  | Pull-ups                 | Increases strength & posture        |
| Chest | Push-ups, Bench Press    | Increases strength & melee power    |

### Performance

* Strength = (Arms + Chest + Back) ÷ 3 → Affects melee damage & recoil
* Stamina = (Core + Legs) ÷ 2 → Affects sprint duration & swimming

### Boosts & Recovery

* Protein Shake ($75): +50% XP gain for 10 minutes + restores hunger
* Pre-Workout ($100): 30% reduced fatigue for 5 minutes + restores thirst
* Yoga: Relieves fatigue naturally

### Training Tips

* Watch your Fatigue bar - hit 100% and you'll get a 5-minute training penalty!
* Train the Daily Focus stat first for faster gains
* Use Pre-Workout before long sessions to train longer
* Take Protein Shake to maximize XP from your workout

# Treasure Maps

Hunt for buried loot across San Andreas! Solve clues, track down informants, and dig up valuable treasures ranging from cash to weapons.

### Getting Started

* Acquire Maps: Earn treasure maps from various activities throughout the city
* What You'll Need: A Shovel to dig up your loot
* Time Limits: Maps expire after 30-60 minutes - act fast!

### Map Tiers

| Tier   | Difficulty | NPCs to Find   | Time Limit |
| ------ | ---------- | -------------- | ---------- |
| Tier 1 | Easy       | 0 (Direct map) | 30 min     |
| Tier 2 | Medium     | 1 NPC          | 45 min     |
| Tier 3 | Hard       | 2 NPCs         | 60 min     |
| Tier 4 | Expert     | 3 NPCs + Items | 60 min     |

### How It Works

<details>

<summary>Tier 1 - Direct Hunt:</summary>

1. Use the map item to view the image
2. Study the clues and location hints
3. Travel to the dig site (no GPS help!)
4. Dig up your treasure

</details>

<details>

<summary>Tier 2 - One Informant:</summary>

1. Use the map to set GPS to an NPC
2. Talk to the NPC to view the treasure map
3. Solve the clues and travel to the dig site
4. Dig up your treasure

</details>

<details>

<summary>Tier 3 - Two Informants:</summary>

1. Use the map to set GPS to the first NPC
2. First NPC gives you a hint and directs you to a second NPC
3. Second NPC shows you the actual treasure map
4. Solve the clues and dig up your loot

</details>

<details>

<summary>Tier 4 - Three Informants + Items</summary>

1. Track down multiple NPCs in sequence
2. Some NPCs require items to bribe or trade (burgers, SD cards, etc.)
3. Final NPC reveals the treasure location
4. Complete the hunt and claim rare rewards

</details>

# Pawnshop Rings

Craft powerful magical rings at the Pawnshop to gain unique passive buffs! Each ring provides a different advantage but loses durability over time.

### What You'll Need

* Find a Pawnshop employee when the shop is open
* Bring Celestial Alloy - The rare material required for ALL rings
* Bring the required gems and materials

### The Rings

| Ring            | Effect                                                        | Durability Loss  |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| Ruby Ring       | Regenerates 2 HP every 15 seconds                             | 0.5% per minute  |
| Sapphire Ring   | Regenerates armor to 33% (2 armor/15s)                        | 0.5% per minute  |
| Emerald Ring    | Restores stamina when sprinting (5 uses, then 1 min cooldown) | 0.5% per minute  |
| Citrine Ring    | Removes 2 stress every 15 seconds                             | 0.5% per minute  |
| Aquamarine Ring | Faster swimming speed                                         | 0.5% per minute  |
| Onyx Ring       | Way slower hunger and thirst drain                            | 0.25% per minute |

### Usage & Maintenance

* Activation: Costs 2% durability instantly
* Passive Drain: Rings lose durability while active
* Repair: Use a Ring Repair Kit at the Pawnshop repair bench (requires Pawnshop employee)
* Cooldown: 5 seconds between equipping different rings
* One at a Time: Only one ring buff can be active

### Pro Tips

* Onyx Ring is the most efficient (0.25% drain vs 0.5%)
* Ruby & Sapphire great for combat survivability
* Emerald perfect for runners and job activities
* Aquamarine essential for diving activities
* Monitor durability - rings break at 0% and need repair!

wikiPages.title: Fishing Lures
wikiPages.content:
# Fishing Lures

> **Note:** You can craft Fishing Lures at the Marina table!

**Fishing Lures**

Fishing Lures can be crafted or found in Treasure Chests! They're an excellent way to improve both your chances of catching fish and the frequency of your catches.

Each lure is unique and designed for specific fishing rods. Be sure to check the item's tooltip to see which rod your lure is compatible with!

**Lure Effects:** Lures last for 30 minutes once activated and provide several benefits while active:

* **Faster Fishing:** Reduces the time between catch attempts, letting you fish more in less time
* **Better Catch Rate:** Increases your chance of successfully reeling in a fish
* **Rarer Catches:** Shifts the odds in your favor, making rare and valuable fish more likely to bite
* **Bonus XP:** Earn extra fishing experience with every catch

**Lure Tiers:**

| Lure          | Compatible Rods        | Overview                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Basic Lure    | Basic Rod              | A modest boost to get you started, slightly faster catches and a small bump to your odds                                                       |
| Advanced Lure | Saltwater Rod, Fly Rod | A solid upgrade, noticeably faster fishing, better catch rates, and improved chances at uncommon fish                                          |
| Expert Lure   | Deepsea Rod            | The best lure available, significantly faster fishing, the highest catch rate bonus, and a major shift toward rare fish like Sharks and Whales |

**Tips:**

* Only one lure can be active at a time
* Lures stack with Hotspot bonuses! Fish in a Hotspot with a lure active for the best results
* You'll get a notification when your lure helps attract a catch, so you'll know it's working!

wikiPages.title: Upgrading Your Rig
wikiPages.content:
# Upgrading Your Rig

Your starter rig is just the beginning! To truly maximize your mining potential, you'll need to upgrade to Tier 2 and Tier 3 components.

**The Hidden Workshop**: \
Digital Den only has the basics. To craft Tier 2 and Tier 3 upgrades, as well as Advanced Electronic Repair Kits, you'll need to locate the secret electronics workshop hidden somewhere in the city. This crafting location is where serious miners go to build high performance components. Ask around, someone might know where it is!

**Gathering Materials**: \
Upgrading requires special materials you won't find at any store. You'll need to gather components from various activities around the city, such as Dumpster Diving, Garbage Job, House Robberies, Chop shop, and more!\
\
**Mining Efficiency & Hardware Score:** \
Every component in your miner contributes to your Hardware Score, which determines how efficiently you mine and which cryptocurrencies you can access. A basic rig starts around 135 points, enough to mine Shungite. To unlock X Coin, you'll need at least 200 points, which means an extra GPU or upgrading to Tier 2 parts. The premium LME requires 300+ points and serious hardware investment. 

> TIP: The higher your score, the faster you mine and the more you earn. Keep your parts healthy though! Damaged components contribute less to your score!

| Component    | What It Does                                               |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| GPU          | More mining power! Stack up to 4 for massive multipliers   |
| Motherboard  | Determines how many GPUs you can install (2/3/4)           |
| RAM          | Boosts mining speed with each stick (up to 4)              |
| Cooling      | Improves overall efficiency                                |
| Power Supply | Powers your GPUs (bigger PSU = more GPUs)                  |
| Storage      | Determines how much crypto you can hold before withdrawing |

wikiPages.title: Maintenance & Repairs
wikiPages.content:
# Maintenance & Repairs

Your components wear down over time while actively mining. Keep an eye on their health!

> **Note:** : Higher tier parts last longer AND can be repaired more times. Finding that hidden workshop and investing in upgrades saves money long term!

### Health System

Parts degrade based on active mining time (not real time). When any part drops below 25% health, your miner stops working.

### Repair Kits

| Repair Kit                     | Tiers it Repairs      | How to Get                                       | Price                |
| ------------------------------ | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------- |
| Basic Electronic Repair Kit    | Tier 1 parts only     | Purchasable at Digital Den                       | $1,150               |
| Advanced Electronic Repair Kit | Tier 2 & Tier 3 parts | Craftable at Electronics Table (hidden location) | \~$1,150 (materials) |

### Repair Limits:

* Tier 1 parts: Can be repaired 2 times before replacement
* Tier 2 parts: Can be repaired 3 times before replacement 
* Tier 3 parts: Can be repaired 4 times before replacement

> **Note:** : Repairing a part does NOT reset its age! Old parts that have been mining for weeks will degrade quickly again after repair.

# Getting Started

Starting a Gang can be overwhelming, luckily, we curated some information to help you start!

### Getting Started

Starting a gang in CityLife is not a decision to be taken lightly. Building a reputation on the streets takes time, dedication, and the right people by your side. Before jumping in, consider the following:

* Establishing your gang takes time: You won't become a powerhouse overnight. Expect progression to require sustained activity before major features unlock.
* Choose your members wisely: Every member you recruit reflects on your gang. Bring in people you trust who are committed to the long-term vision, not just anyone looking for quick action.
* Quality over quantity: A tight knit crew of 6 reliable members will outperform 20 randoms who don't communicate or work together.
* Roleplay properly: Gang roleplay should enhance the server experience for everyone. Follow all server rules, avoid RDM & VDM, and create meaningful stories and rivalries.
* Respect the grind - The progression system is designed to reward consistent effort. There are no shortcuts.

***

####  Commands

| Command   | Description                                                |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| /gangmenu | Open the gang management menu (create, recruit, view info) |
| /gang     | Quick gang information                                     |

***

####  Costs

| Action           | Cost                   |
| ---------------- | ---------------------- |
| Create a Gang    | 2,000 SHUNG ($100,000) |
| Recruit a Member | 400 SHUNG ($20,000)    |

***

#### Tips for Success

1. Communicate - Use radios, or in game voice to coordinate (Not Discord)
2. Diversify activities - Don't just grind one thing; mix heists, boosting, and drug ops
3. Build alliances - Not every gang needs to be an enemy
4. Protect your reputation - How you carry yourself matters in the criminal underworld
5. Stay active - Inactive gangs fall behind, keep your crew engaged

# Gang Unlocks

This article describes the available unlocks you can obtain as you level your Gang!

## Earning XP as a Gang

Your gang earns XP through various criminal activities across the city.. XP is awarded for completing heists, robberies, boosting vehicles, and other illegal operations. Higher tier activities reward more XP for example, a Pacific Standard bank job grants significantly more than an ATM robbery. Each gang member receives the full XP amount (not split), but there's a 1,000 XP cap per player per restart to prevent power leveling. Notably, selling drugs from your own grow operation does not grant XP; however, selling another gang's product will award XP to the gang who grew it. Complete eligible activities to progress through the levels and unlock warehouses, upgrades, and eventually the ability to raid rival gang operations at level 25.

# Whitelisted Gangs

 This article describes the available unlocks you obtain when your gang is officially Whitelisted!!

#### Official Territory

Whitelisted gangs receive designated territory on the map.. This area becomes your gang's turf where you can establish dominance, conduct operations, and defend against rivals.

#### Gang Sprays & Graffiti

* Claim Territory - Spray your gang's custom graffiti on walls to mark turf
* Turf Radius - Each spray claims a radius around it
* NPC Dealers - Gang NPCs spawn near your sprays
* Contest Rival Sprays - Scratch enemy graffiti to take over their territory
* Spray Shop - Purchase spray cans (price scales with level) and spray remover

#### Crafting Bench

Each whitelisted gang receives a dedicated crafting bench at a unique location. At the bench, gang members can craft:

* Weapons
* Ammunition
* Armor
* Gang-exclusive items
* Other crafting recipes

#### Rob Law Enforcement

Whitelisted gangs gain access to the ability to rob police officers. This high risk activity allows gang members to take items from law enforcement during confrontations. Whitelisted gangs are trusted to not abuse this ability.
